name: ARCHIVED_NYPD Shooting Incident Data (Historic)
description:
This dataset contains archived New York Police Department records of shooting incidents in New York City. Each row represents a single shooting incident and includes the date and time it occurred, the borough, precinct, and jurisdiction, whether it happened inside or outside, and a classification of the location such as street, housing, dwelling, or commercial. Records also include a flag indicating whether the incident was a statistical murder, along with demographic details for the perpetrator and victim, including age group, sex, and race. Geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, and a point geometry) are provided for most incidents, allowing them to be mapped.

The sample covers 5,000 rows with 21 columns. Incidents are concentrated in the Bronx and Brooklyn, and most occurred outside on streets. Perpetrator information is missing in roughly a third of records, while victim demographics are complete. Location descriptions are missing for about 17% of rows, and coordinates are missing for about 2%.

The data can be used to analyze trends
